entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I think I need to return something? I have this VeloBand Pulse, and I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. Just to be clear, what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
Oh, no, it works fine! It was a total impulse buy, to be honest. I just changed my mind and I really don't use it. The website was a bit overwhelming... Can't you just help me?
Of course, I understand completely. I just need to pull up your account. Can you please provide me with the order number?
Sure, one second... It's VF78-010126-P. I got it right after New Year's.

Thank you. I see the order here, delivered on January 1st. So, you've had it for about 18 days. Okay, I see. Since this isn't a defect, and it is a matter of preference, typically we would point you toward our VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a great platform for...
Oh, a resale thing? That sounds so complicated. I wouldn't even know where to start. I just want to send it back. Is there really nothing you can do?
You know what, let me just double-check the return eligibility for you. One moment please... Okay, I'm looking at our policy now.
And... yes, you're good to go. It looks like you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.
Oh, really? Ninety days? That's such a relief! Thank you so much, Diana. I was so worried.

It's no problem at all. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. You'll receive a full refund once we receive the item.
That's perfect. Thank you again, you've been a huge help!
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. Have a great day!
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
